tagline: King取景器相机，1958 年发布
description: King于1958年推出的取景器相机。配备Steinheil Cassar 45mm f/2.8。快门速度Vero - Bulb, 1/25, 1/50, 1/100 and 1/200th.。使用Lever for the advance。

specs.闪光灯: PC socket on the side of the lens, accessory shoe on top of the camera
specs.英文简介: The Mastra V35 35mm viewfinder camera was made in Germany by King, c.1958 as a simpler version of the Regula IIIa.
